name: @citadela/cli
description: Citadela command-line interface and terminal UI.

scripts.build:native:windows: pnpm build && pnpm dlx bun build --compile --minify --conditions=bun,node dist/native-entry.js --outfile dist/bin/citadela-win32-x64.exe
scripts.build:native:linux: pnpm build && pnpm dlx bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --conditions=bun,node dist/native-entry.js --outfile dist/bin/citadela-linux-x64
scripts.build:native:linux-arm64: pnpm build && pnpm dlx bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --conditions=bun,node dist/native-entry.js --outfile dist/bin/citadela-linux-arm64
